interpretation: Matched, fold-safe retraining of the published LogBB_Pred modelling strategy on the supplied dataset and fixed folds.
missing_descriptor_policy: drop descriptors with any missing values among measured compounds in each training fit; no imputation
feature_pair_policy: for |feature-feature Pearson r| above threshold, drop the feature with lower absolute Pearson correlation with training logBB
tuning: GridSearchCV scored by negative mean squared error; default candidates lie within Supplementary Table S1 bounds and include the published optimum
